$comment: The machine-specific settings live in settings.local.json, which the tracked .gitignore ignores.
The hook typechecks after every edit - measured at 811ms on this tree before it was chosen,
against an edit loop where the same error otherwise surfaces minutes later inside npm run check.
IT APPENDS ITS EXIT CODE TO .claude/typecheck.log AND THAT IS THE ONLY EVIDENCE IT RAN.
node is not on the Bash PATH here, and docs/machine.md records a whole class of failure found
only by a log the failing process wrote itself, after four correct-sounding theories had been
shipped. A hook believed rather than read is 0199 in a new costume.
To remove it, delete the hooks block.

hooks.command: export PATH="/c/Users/foxor/AppData/Local/gf-node/node-v24.17.0-win-x64:$PATH"; out=$(npm run typecheck 2>&1); ec=$?; printf '%s typecheck exit=%s\n' "$(date -Iseconds)" "$ec" >> .claude/typecheck.log; if [ "$ec" -ne 0 ]; then printf '%s\n' "$out" | tail -30; fi; exit $ec
